metadata.boundary: Runs a selected configuration of the clean pinned official RLM runtime with its prompts and REPL through bounded JSON stdin. Scaffold Lab defaults to Docker plus a 1,500-second RLM timeout, unlike the library defaults of local plus no timeout. Default max_depth=1 provides direct/batched subcalls but no recursive child RLM; configure depth 2 or greater for recursion. The adapter accepts string context and does not expose structured context, custom tools, compaction, persistence, alternate backends, or sampling/orchestrator options. It injects no Scaffold Lab domain tools and makes no SWE patch-parity claim.
metadata.accounting: The v0.1.3 root UsageSummary does not merge recursive child handlers, so calls, tokens, and optional cost are retained only as lower bounds.
